title: Solar-powered machine turns seawater into drinking water in Leyte

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — A small machine that can turn seawater into about a gallon of freshwater every hour could offer hope to island communities struggling with limited access to safe drinking water. Developed by engineering researchers from the Eastern Visayas State University (EVSU) based here, the working desalination prototype uses technology designed to remove salt from seawater, with solar energy providing an alternative power source. The innovation was demonstrated on Kalanggaman Island in Palompon, Leyte, during the final research defense of three candidates under EVSU’s Master of Engineering program.
